name: Cairn 2e
description:
The Cairn 2e rules on their own: everything in this view is the General layer, the reference every universe and campaign here stands on, with nothing of a setting added. Cairn (2nd edition) is by Yochai Gal, CC BY-SA 4.0, at cairnrpg.com.

- **[[rule/players-guide|Player's Guide]]:** [[rule/overview-and-principles|Overview & Principles]], [[rule/character-creation|Character Creation]] (its [[rolltable/character-creation-backgrounds-table|Backgrounds]] table leads to all twenty backgrounds, their gear and their tables), [[rule/core-rules|Core Rules]], [[rule/procedures|Procedures]] and the [[rule/marketplace|Marketplace]].
- **[[rule/wardens-guide|Warden's Guide]]:** [[rule/setting-seeds|Setting Seeds]], [[rule/dungeon-seeds|Dungeon Seeds]], [[rule/forest-seeds|Forest Seeds]], the [[rule/bestiary|Bestiary]] and [[rule/creating-monsters|Creating Monsters]], [[rule/spellbooks|Spellbooks]], the [[rule/reliquary|Reliquary]], and the Warden's chapters on [[rule/saves|Saves]], [[rule/combat|Combat]], [[rule/wilderness-exploration|Wilderness Exploration]], [[rule/growth|Growth]] and the rest.

**Finding your way.** *Texts & Lore* is the books as a tree, chapter by chapter, with every table in its place. *Kinds* holds the things the rules define: Item Types (the Marketplace, the Reliquary, and everything the backgrounds' tables hand out), Spellbooks, Monster Types by category, Backgrounds and Hireling Roles. Search finds any of them by name or text, and the filters narrow a list (spellbooks a monster carries, items of a kind, monsters of a group). Every page lists what it refers to and what refers to it, so a term like _Fatigue_ leads to every rule, item and monster that uses it.
